name: Pine-Wind Zither (Tùng Phong Cầm)
lore: The monk's zither of 620, made of a pine that a storm laid across a ravine of Thâm Tùng Hải. He played it in the pines until it sounded like ten thousand ravines and left it with his listeners, who founded the academy round it (C130). The line it is named for is the poet's: như thính vạn hác tùng, as if hearing the pines in ten thousand ravines. Only the head plays it, and only at the new year.
build_use: The head's song instrument: faster soul arts, longer statuses and an echo on every note.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: The Stringless Zither of Cầm Tượng (Cầm Tượng Vô Huyền Cầm)
lore: The last zither Cù Cổ Đồng finished in Cầm Tượng Trấn, the night before the ravine wall came down on the town in 1012 (V041). He had not strung it yet. His son Cù Đồng Mộc dug it out of the rubble and has never strung it either. He plays it with his fingers on the bare wood, and the students swear they can hear it.
build_use: The maker's instrument: cheaper songs after a silence, and a guard against soul arts.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Beads of the Held Rest (Đình Âm Niệm Châu)
lore: Twelve pine-seed beads the monk counted rests on, one bead for each beat of silence. They were found with the zither in 620.
build_use: Faster song arts and longer silences.

name: Robe of the Ravine Wind (Hác Phong Bào)
lore: The monk's patched travelling robe, so thin the ravine wind plays it. The academy's heads wear it once a year, at the playing of the zither.
build_use: The player's guard: evasion and linh lực while the song goes on.
